Definition: of Hebrew origin (H7141); Core (i.e. Korach), an Israelite:--Core.
BiblicalUsage: Core is Korah, the Israelite who rose against Moses and Aaron. Jude 1:11 pronounces woe on those who have perished in the gainsaying of Core, beside the way of Cain and the error of Balaam.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Korah's name stands in Jude as the third warning: Cain's way, Balaam's error, and Korah's gainsaying, and all three end in perishing.
RelatedPeople: Korah, Son of Izhar; Moses; Aaron
